benchmark_name: 剑桥大学 ATM-Bench 多模态个人指称记忆基准 · Rolling Autonoetic Memory Engine (the memory engine)
benchmark_name_en: University of Cambridge ATM-Bench · Rolling Autonoetic Memory Engine (the memory engine)
corpus_summary: 4 年真实跨度 · 11,034 条 SGM 多模态个人记忆（6,742 封邮件 + 3,759 张带 GPS/OCR 照片 + 533 段视频）· 统一采用 Rolling Autonoetic Memory Engine（洛灵自知记忆引擎）评测
corpus_summary_en: 4-year span · 11,034 SGM multimodal personal memories (6,742 emails + 3,759 GPS/OCR photos + 533 videos) · Evaluated on Rolling Autonoetic Memory Engine (the memory engine)
repro_command: rmem eval --suite atm --tier hard --pulse-mode local_plain --top-k 50 --answerer none --judge off

hard_entries.architecture: 人工标注金标证据直投 (Ground-Truth Evidence Direct Injection)
hard_entries.note: ATM-Bench-Hard 31 题人工金标证据直投理论上限：R@25/R@50 均为 100%，R@10 = 96.47% 是结构性上限（4 题金标为 12–17 条 > retrieveK=10，Σmin(10,gold)/gold/31 = 96.47%）；即使给全金标证据，大模型在跨年多跳计数与列表召回上的混合 QS 上限为 46.69%。
hard_entries.note_en: ATM-Bench-Hard 31-question gold-evidence ceiling: R@25/R@50 are 100%, while R@10 = 96.47% is the structural maximum (4 questions carry 12–17 gold items > retrieveK=10; Σmin(10,gold)/gold/31 = 96.47%); even with full gold evidence, the hybrid QS ceiling is 46.69%.

hard_entries.note: v0.0.3 本地明文臂（local_plain · Zhao 四步双簇内核）在 11,034 条 SGM 多模态记忆上实测：全量建库导入 15.17s（0.0042 hr，冷启 mmap 39ms），单题检索 38.4ms；Hard-31 官方 Recall@10=50.35%（逐题金标交均）、R@20=59.89%、R@50=70.20%、Any-Hit@10=80.65% (25/31)、All-Hit@10=29.03% (9/31)、官方混合 QS=27.38%。

hard_entries.architecture_en: Cloud LLM Memory Extraction + Dense/Sparse Hybrid Retrieval · 11,034 1:1 Writes Across Two Accounts · Dual-Shard Top-50 RRF · Top-10 Delivery
hard_entries.highlight_tag: 第三方云记忆自测 · Hard R@10 24.17% / QS 7.99%
hard_entries.highlight_tag_en: Third-Party Cloud Memory (Self-Measured) · Hard R@10 24.17% / QS 7.99%
hard_entries.note: 自测口径声明：调用 MemoraX 官方云端 API（platform.memoraxai.com /v1/memories/{add,search}），11,034 条 SGM 以 1:1 逐条写入（metadata.atm_unit_id 精确归因），A/B 两个独立账号各 5,517 条；检索时两片各取 top-50 并以 RRF(k=60) 融合，Answer/Judge 与本榜同一官方协议（retrieveK=10 等量交付）。Hard-31：R@10 24.17% / R@25 34.42% / R@50 55.90%，Hit@10 64.52%，官方混合 QS 7.99%（List 8.33% / Num 0% / Open 0%）。建库总耗时 23h07m（写入 1h06m + 异步抽取 22h01m 到 92% 可检索）；口径偏差：双账号分片（每片半库）与异步抽取（开跑覆盖率 ~92%）≠ 单索引全库；非官方榜读数。
hard_entries.note_en: Self-measured disclosure: MemoraX official cloud API (platform.memoraxai.com /v1/memories/{add,search}); 11,034 SGM items written 1:1 (exact metadata.atm_unit_id attribution) across two independent accounts (5,517 each); retrieval queries both shards at top-50 and fuses with RRF(k=60); Answer/Judge use the same official protocol as this board (retrieveK=10). Hard-31: R@10 24.17% / R@25 34.42% / R@50 55.90%, Hit@10 64.52%, hybrid QS 7.99% (List 8.33% / Num 0% / Open 0%). Total build time 23h07m (1h06m writes + 22h01m async extraction to 92% searchable); protocol deviations: dual-shard half-corpus indexing and async extraction (~92% coverage at run start) differ from a single full index; not an official leaderboard entry.
